sections.text: Privacy Policy

At Xntrova Technologies, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, process, store, and protect information when you visit or interact with our website, www.xntrova.com, contact us, request our services, or otherwise communicate with us.

Xntrova Technologies is a digital marketing agency providing services including search engine optimisation (SEO), paid advertising/PPC, social media marketing, e-commerce marketing, content marketing, website development, email marketing, and other digital marketing solutions.
By using our website or voluntarily providing your information to us, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
1. Information We Collect
We may collect information that you voluntarily provide to us when you use our website, submit a form, request a consultation, communicate with our team, or engage our services.
Depending on how you interact with us, the information we may collect includes:
Personal Information
Full name
Email address
Phone/mobile number
Company or organisation name
Website URL
Business or professional information
Information included in your enquiry or project requirements
Any other information you voluntarily provide to us
Automatically Collected Information
When you visit our website, certain information may be collected automatically through cookies, analytics tools, server logs, pixels, and similar technologies. This may include:
IP address
Browser type and version
Device type
Operating system
Approximate geographic location
Pages visited
Time spent on pages
Referring website or source
Date and time of website access
Website interaction and usage information
This information may be used to understand website performance, improve user experience, analyse traffic, and improve our marketing activities.
2. How We Collect Information
We may collect information through:
Contact and enquiry forms on our website
Free digital audit or consultation forms
Emails and other direct communications
Phone calls or other business communications
Website usage and analytics technologies
Cookies and similar tracking technologies
Information provided during service enquiries or client onboarding
Other legitimate interactions with Xntrova
Our website currently uses forms through which visitors may provide information such as name, email address, phone number, company name, website URL, and information about how they heard about us.
3. How We Use Your Information
We may use the information we collect for legitimate business purposes, including:
Responding to your enquiries and requests
Providing consultations and digital audits
Understanding your business and marketing requirements
Preparing proposals, quotations, and service plans
Providing and managing our services
Communicating with existing and prospective clients
Improving our website, services, content, and user experience
Managing client relationships
Sending relevant service-related communications
Measuring website traffic and marketing performance
Conducting analytics and research
Detecting, preventing, and addressing fraud, misuse, security incidents, or technical problems
Complying with applicable legal and regulatory obligations
Protecting our rights, property, and business interests
We do not use your personal information for purposes that are materially different from those described in this Privacy Policy without providing appropriate notice where required by applicable law.
4. Marketing Communications
If you provide your contact information to Xntrova, we may contact you regarding your enquiry, requested services, business requirements, or related information.
Where required by applicable law, we will obtain appropriate consent before sending promotional or marketing communications.

You may request to stop receiving marketing communications from us at any time by contacting us using the details provided below or by using an unsubscribe option included in applicable communications.
Please note that you may still receive essential communications relating to an existing enquiry, service, transaction, or business relationship.
5. Cookies and Similar Technologies
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality, understand website usage, analyze traffic, measure marketing performance, and provide a better user experience.
Cookies may be used for purposes such as:
Essential website functionality
Website analytics
Performance measurement
Advertising and campaign measurement
Remembering user preferences
Understanding how visitors interact with our website
Third-party services used on our website may also place cookies or similar technologies on your device.
You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect some website functionality.
Where legally required, we may provide additional cookie choices or consent mechanisms.
6. Analytics and Third-Party Services
We may use third-party technologies and service providers to help us understand website traffic, measure marketing campaigns, improve website performance, and provide our services.
These providers may process information according to their own privacy policies and terms.
Examples may include website analytics, advertising platforms, CRM systems, hosting providers, communication tools, payment providers, and other technology or marketing platforms used by Xntrova.
We encourage users to review the privacy policies of third-party services when appropriate.
7. Sharing of Personal Information
Xntrova does not sell your personal information as a business practice.
We may share information with trusted third parties where reasonably necessary to operate our business, provide services, or fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.
These parties may include:
Hosting and website infrastructure providers
Analytics providers
Advertising and marketing platforms
CRM and business management platforms
Email and communication service providers
IT and security service providers
Professional advisers
Payment and transaction service providers
Government authorities or law enforcement agencies where legally required
Third-party service providers may process information on our behalf and may be subject to contractual, legal, or technical safeguards as applicable.
8. Client Information

When you engage Xntrova for digital marketing services, we may receive information relating to your business, website, marketing campaigns, customers, analytics accounts, advertising platforms, social media accounts, or other digital properties.

We use such information only as reasonably necessary to provide the agreed services, manage the client relationship, communicate with you, maintain security, and meet legal or contractual obligations.
Clients should avoid providing sensitive personal information through ordinary enquiry forms unless it is specifically required for a service.
9. Data Security
We take reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
However, no method of transmitting or storing information over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Accordingly, while we work to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted to or stored by us.
10. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, provide services, maintain business and financial records, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, comply with legal obligations, and protect our legitimate business interests.
The appropriate retention period may vary depending on the nature of the information and the purpose for which it was collected.
When information is no longer reasonably required, we may securely delete, anonymise, or otherwise dispose of it, subject to applicable legal and business requirements.
11. Your Privacy Rights
Depending on your location and applicable privacy laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.
These may include the right to:
Request access to personal information we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
Request deletion of certain personal information
Request restriction of certain processing
Object to certain processing activities
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
Request information about how your personal information is used
Opt out of certain marketing communications
These rights are subject to applicable legal limitations and exceptions.
To make a privacy-related request, please contact us using the contact information provided in this Privacy Policy.
12. Children's Privacy
Our website and services are intended primarily for businesses and professional users.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children where such collection is prohibited by applicable law.
If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us without appropriate authorisation, please contact us so that we can take appropriate action.
13. Third-Party Websites
Our website may contain links to third-party websites, social media platforms, advertising platforms, or other external websites.
Xntrova does not control the privacy practices, content, security, or policies of third-party websites.
When you leave our website, we recommend reviewing the privacy policy of the website you visit before providing personal information.
14. International Data Transfers
Depending on the services and technology providers we use, your information may be processed or stored in countries other than the country in which you are located.
Where applicable, we take reasonable steps to ensure that such processing is carried out in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.
15. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update or modify this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, business practices, legal requirements, or privacy practices.
When we make changes, we may update the “Effective Date” at the beginning of this policy.
We encourage you to review this page periodically to remain informed about how we handle personal information.
16. Contact Us
If you have questions, concerns, requests, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or the way Xntrova handles personal information, please contact us.
Xntrova TechnologiesA107, 2nd Floor, Sector 8, DwarkaNew Delhi – 110077, India
Phone: +91 868-382-8646Email: info@xntrova.comWebsite: www.xntrova.com
You may contact us using the above details for privacy-related requests or questions. Our current website also lists the Delhi office and these contact details.
17. Acceptance of This Privacy Policy
By accessing and using www.xntrova.com, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Policy and understand how Xntrova Technologies may collect and process information as described above.
If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, you should discontinue use of the website where appropriate.

Xntrova Technologies is a digital marketing agency providing services including SEO, PPC and paid advertising, social media marketing, content marketing, e-commerce marketing, website development, email marketing, and related digital marketing services.

You agree not to:
Use the website for any unlawful or fraudulent purpose.
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our website, servers, systems, or databases.
Introduce viruses, malware, or other harmful technologies.
Copy, reproduce, distribute, or modify our website content without permission.

Our services are provided according to the scope and terms agreed with each client.

Digital marketing performance can depend on numerous factors outside our direct control, including search engine algorithms, advertising-platform policies, competition, market conditions, website quality, client actions, and changes in technology.

Therefore, unless expressly guaranteed in a written agreement, Xntrova does not guarantee specific search rankings, website traffic, leads, conversions, sales, revenue, advertising results, or other business outcomes.
4. Client Responsibilities
Clients are responsible for providing accurate, complete, and timely information, materials, access credentials, approvals, and other resources reasonably required to perform the agreed services.
Clients must ensure that information, images, trademarks, content, products, and other materials supplied to Xntrova do not infringe the rights of third parties or violate applicable laws.
Delays in providing required information, approvals, or access may affect project timelines and deliverables.
5. Intellectual Property

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the Xntrova website, including its text, graphics, branding, designs, layouts, logos, original content, and other materials, is owned by or licensed to Xntrova Technologies and may not be reproduced or commercially used without prior written permission.
Ownership of client-specific deliverables will be governed by the applicable proposal, contract, or service agreement.
Third-party materials, software, platforms, trademarks, and intellectual property remain the property of their respective owners.
6. Payments and Fees
Service fees, payment schedules, taxes, billing terms, cancellation conditions, and other financial arrangements will be specified in the applicable quotation, proposal, invoice, or agreement.
Failure to make payments within the agreed period may result in suspension or termination of services.
Any applicable taxes, platform charges, advertising budgets, third-party costs, or other expenses will be handled according to the agreed commercial terms.
7. Third-Party Platforms
Our services may involve third-party platforms such as search engines, advertising networks, social media platforms, hosting providers, analytics tools, and other external services.

Xntrova does not control the policies, availability, algorithms, functionality, pricing, or decisions of these third parties. Changes made by such platforms may affect the services or results provided to clients.
8. Confidentiality

We may receive confidential business information while providing our services. Xntrova will take reasonable measures to protect confidential information and use it only for legitimate business or service-related purposes, subject to applicable agreements and laws.
9. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Xntrova Technologies will not be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or business losses arising from the use of our website or services, including loss of profits, revenue, data, business opportunities, or expected marketing results.
Nothing in these Terms is intended to exclude liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.
10. Privacy
Your use of our website is also subject to our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and protect personal information.
11. Changes to These Terms
Xntrova Technologies may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Updated terms will be published on this page with a revised effective or updated date.
Your continued use of the website after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
12. Governing Law

These Terms & Conditions shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the applicable laws of India. Any disputes arising in connection with these Terms or our services shall be subject to the applicable jurisdiction of courts in India.

Cookie Policy – Xntrova Technologies

At Xntrova Technologies, accessible through www.xntrova.com, we value your privacy and are committed to providing a secure and transparent browsing experience. This Cookie Policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website.
1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites function properly, remember user preferences, analyse website traffic, and improve the overall browsing experience.
2. How We Use Cookies
Xntrova Technologies may use cookies and similar tracking technologies for the following purposes:
Essential Cookies: To ensure our website functions correctly and securely.
Performance and Analytics Cookies: To understand visitor behaviour, website traffic, and page performance.
Functional Cookies: To remember user preferences and improve website usability.
Marketing Cookies: To measure advertising performance, deliver relevant advertisements, and understand campaign effectiveness.
These cookies may be set by third-party service providers, such as analytics and advertising platforms.
3. Third-Party Cookies

Our website may use third-party tools, including analytics services, advertising platforms, and social media integrations. These providers may collect certain browsing information according to their own privacy and cookie policies. Xntrova Technologies does not control third-party cookies and encourages users to review the relevant policies.
4. Managing Cookies

You can manage, disable, or delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block cookies or receive notifications before they are stored. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality and your browsing experience.
Where required by applicable law, we will seek your consent before placing non-essential cookies on your device.
5. Updates to This Cookie Policy

Xntrova Technologies reserves the right to update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or our business practices. Any updates will be published on this page with a revised date.
6. Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Cookie Policy, please contact us:

Refund & Cancellation Policy

At Xntrova, we are committed to providing professional digital marketing and technology services that meet our clients’ business requirements. This Refund & Cancellation Policy explains the terms applicable to payments, service cancellations, and refunds for services purchased through our website or directly from Xntrova.
1. Service Payments

Payments made to Xntrova for SEO, PPC/paid advertising, social media marketing, content marketing, e-commerce marketing, website development, email marketing, or other agreed services are processed according to the commercial terms specified in the applicable proposal, quotation, invoice, or service agreement.

Any third-party costs, including advertising platform charges, domain registration, hosting, software subscriptions, paid tools, licenses, or other external services, may be non-refundable once incurred.
2. Cancellation by Client
Clients may request cancellation of an ongoing service by providing written notice to Xntrova. The applicable notice period, if any, will be as specified in the service agreement or proposal.

Cancellation requests will not automatically result in a refund. Services already completed, work in progress, resources allocated, third-party expenses, or other committed costs may be deducted from any amount eligible for refund.
3. Refund Eligibility
Refunds are considered on a case-by-case basis and depend on the nature of the service, work completed, payment terms, and applicable agreement.

Advance payments for customized services, completed work, or services that have already commenced may generally not be refundable. Digital marketing results may also depend on factors outside Xntrova’s control, including search-engine algorithms, advertising platforms, market conditions, competition, website performance, and client-provided information. Therefore, payment is not refundable solely because a particular ranking, traffic level, lead volume, or conversion target has not been achieved unless specifically guaranteed in writing.
4. Refund Processing

Where a refund is approved, Xntrova will process the eligible amount through the original payment method, where reasonably possible. Processing time may vary depending on the payment provider or financial institution.
5. Cancellation by Xntrova

Xntrova reserves the right to suspend or terminate services in cases of non-payment, misuse of services, violation of agreed terms, or other material breaches. Any refund, if applicable, will be determined according to the relevant agreement and work completed.
6. Contact Us

For cancellation or refund-related requests, please contact us at info@xntrova.com or call +91 868-382-8646. Written requests should include the client/company name, invoice details, service purchased, and reason for the request.
Xntrova reserves the right to update this policy when necessary. Any changes will be published on this page.
